# This historical event is known as the Malabar Hills Murder or Bawla Murder Case of 1925.
# Mumtaz had escaped from the clutches of Maharaja Tukojirao III of Indore, who had held her captive for years.
# The murder plot was traced back to the Maharaja's men, who were attempting to kidnap Mumtaz and bring her back to Indore.
# The case became a sensation, with prominent figures like Muhammad Ali Jinnah serving as the defense counsel for the accused.
